The source notes separate query retrieval, candidate evidence, response
comparison, reranking, and learned fusion. That map is a planning aid, not
evidence that every borrowed technique will transfer.

## Why this matters for 2026

It shows which parts of the prior playbook have already received bounded tests
and which remain prospective.

## What this does not prove

A participant's reported success is not a directly comparable local result. See
[`reports/trec_2026_approaches_guide_source_notes.md`](../../../reports/trec_2026_approaches_guide_source_notes.md).
